column1: # files components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode  files  -  files under the directory         default
mode  dirs   -  directories under the directory   -
mode  grep   -  search file contents as you type  restart
toggle  hidden   alt-h  hidden files and directories (dotfiles)            on
toggle  ignored  alt-i  files .gitignore and .ignore exclude                -
toggle  follow   alt-l  follow symbolic links into directories             -
action  edit  ctrl-e  open in $EDITOR (grep: at the matching line)  foreground
